metaShifts.description: Following 7.34's support enhancement, this patch applies targeted nerfs to overperforming supports while buffing underutilized ones. Witch Doctor receives comprehensive nerfs (Death Ward range, cooldown, damage), while Glimmer Cape cooldown increases. Conversely, Spirit Vessel becomes more accessible with 200 gold cost reduction, and heroes like Vengeful Spirit, Dazzle, and Omniknight receive meaningful buffs.

The patch addresses overperforming carries from the slow resistance meta. Phantom Assassin loses base agility and Phantom Strike gets creep penalty, while Riki faces comprehensive nerfs (attack speed, smoke screen, talents). Meanwhile, underperforming carries like Luna receive significant buffs (Eclipse cooldown, Aghanim's Shard improvements) and Morphling gets survivability through strength gain.

After becoming Universal in 7.34, Invoker's oppressive presence gets targeted nerfs. Wex no longer provides item cooldown reduction (eliminating BKB/Refresher abuse), Ghost Walk regeneration is heavily nerfed and disabled after taking damage, and base armor is reduced. This directly counters his 7.34 rehabilitation without reverting the Universal status.

Offlane heroes receive buffs focused on their utility and teamfight contribution rather than laning dominance. Magnus gets substantial Empower buffs (damage and cleave), Bristleback gains strength and mana regen, and Treant Protector's Leech Seed improves. These changes favor teamfight-oriented offlaners over pure lane dominators.

synergisticWinners.synergyExplanation: Magnus receives massive Empower buffs (+4% damage and cleave at all levels), creating powerful synergies with carries who benefit from both damage amplification and cleave. Heroes like Sven, Phantom Assassin (despite her nerfs), and Troll Warlord become significantly stronger when paired with Magnus.

Spirit Vessel's 200 gold cost reduction makes it more accessible for heroes who can reliably proc its DOT effect. Heroes like Venomancer, Viper, and Jakiro can build it earlier and more frequently, enhancing their kill potential and teamfight contribution.

Luna's Aghanim's Shard receives significant buffs (orbit radius 150→175, collision radius 90→115) combined with Eclipse cooldown reduction (140/130/120→110). This creates a powerful mid-game spike for Luna builds that prioritize Shard timing.

synergisticLosers.synergyExplanation: Wex no longer providing item cooldown reduction eliminates Invoker's ability to abuse BKB, Refresher Orb, and other high-impact items. This removes a core synergy that made Invoker oppressive in the previous patch's Universal rework.

Smoke Screen losing its linger duration (0.5s→0s) eliminates Riki's ability to create extended disable zones for team setups. Combined with attack speed nerfs, this significantly weakens Riki's teamfight contribution and synergy with AOE ultimates.

Death Ward range reduction (700→600) and talent nerfs (+100→+75 range) make Witch Doctor significantly more vulnerable during ultimate usage. This weakens synergies with heroes who provide positioning assistance like Magnus or Dark Seer.

Carry.explanation: Eclipse cooldown reduction to flat 110s at all levels provides consistent teamfight presence, while Aghanim's Shard buffs (orbit radius +25, collision radius +25) significantly improve her farming and teamfight capabilities.
Strength gain increase (3.0→3.2) provides crucial survivability improvements for a hero that typically builds minimal HP items, making him more viable in the current burst-heavy meta.

Mid.explanation: Dragon Slave burn duration increase (2s→3s) improves farming efficiency and harassment, while talent buffs across multiple levels (+20→+25 damage, +275→+325 health) enhance her scaling potential.

Offlane.explanation: Empower receives massive buffs with damage (12/20/28/36%→16/24/32/40%) and cleave (10/20/30/40%→16/24/32/40%) increases, making him an exceptional teamfight enabler and carry amplifier.
Strength gain increase (2.5→2.7) and base mana regen buff (0.25→0.4) address his sustainability issues, making him more viable in extended teamfights and laning phases.
Base armor increase (+1) and Chemical Rage movement speed buffs (20/40/60→30/45/60) improve his survivability and mobility, crucial for his aggressive farming and fighting style.

SoftSupport.explanation: Magic Missile stun duration increase (1.1/1.2/1.3/1.4s→1.4/1.5/1.6/1.7s) provides significantly more reliable disable, making her a stronger roaming and teamfight support.
Splinter Blast improvements (mana cost reduction, cooldown 7s→6s) and talent buffs (+2s→+3s Arctic Burn duration) enhance her farming, harassment, and teamfight control capabilities.

HardSupport.explanation: Shadow Wave heal/damage increase (60/85/110/135→75/95/115/135) improves his laning presence and teamfight impact, making him more viable as a defensive support.
Repel cooldown reduction (60/55/50/45s→60/52/44/36s) significantly improves his utility in teamfights and ability to protect cores from magical burst.

Carry.explanation: Base agility reduction (-2) weakens her early game damage and attack speed, while Phantom Strike lifesteal penalty on creeps (40%) reduces her farming efficiency and sustain.
Base attack speed reduction (100→90), Smoke Screen linger removal (0.5s→0s), and multiple talent nerfs significantly weaken his teamfight contribution and scaling potential.
Strength gain reduction (3→2.8) decreases his natural tankiness, making him more vulnerable in the early-mid game despite the Aghanim's Scepter cooldown buff.

Mid.explanation: Wex item cooldown removal eliminates BKB/Refresher abuse, Ghost Walk regeneration nerfs (health 10→80 to 10→45, mana 5→40 to 2.5→20) and damage-based regen disable significantly reduce his survivability and utility.
Base damage reduction (-2), Burrowstrike damage nerfs, and Sandstorm movement speed early game nerfs (100 to 25/50/75/100) weaken his laning and ganking potential as a mid laner.

Offlane.explanation: Aghanim's Shard Hunter in the Night nerfs (mana cost 0→50, cooldown 20s→30s) reduce his farming efficiency and teamfight mobility, key aspects of his offlane performance.
Drunken Brawler critical damage reduction (145/160/175/190%→120/140/160/180%) significantly weakens his damage output and scaling potential in the offlane role.

SoftSupport.explanation: Multiple talent nerfs (attack range +275→+250, Macropyre damage +30→+25) and Aghanim's Scepter slow reduction (70%→60%) weaken his teamfight control and positioning capabilities.
Base attack speed reduction (100→90) and Fatal Bonds imp movement speed nerfs weaken his laning harassment and teamfight contribution as a support.

HardSupport.explanation: Comprehensive nerfs including base damage (-3), intelligence gain reduction (3.3→3.1), Death Ward range (700→600) and cooldown (60s→100/80/60s) nerfs, plus multiple talent reductions significantly weaken his impact.
